name: Nest Hub 2nd Gen (UK)

radios.note: Dual-band Wi-Fi 802.11b/g/n/ac (2.4 and 5 GHz), Bluetooth 5.0 and a built-in Thread border router (802.15.4 at 2.4 GHz), per the UK Google Store spec page.

matter.note: The UK spec page lists Matter as supported. No CSA product listing naming it was found, so a certificate is not confirmed.

apple_home.note: No official source shows Nest Hub-paired devices in Apple Home.

google_home.note: Google's UK spec page says the Nest Hub works as a hub for Google Home and lists Matter as supported.

alexa.note: No official source shows Nest Hub-paired devices in Alexa.

smartthings.note: No official source shows Nest Hub-paired devices in SmartThings.

home_assistant.note: Home Assistant's Thread page lists Nest Hub (2nd gen) as a Thread border router; it does not say devices paired in Google Home appear in Home Assistant.

hubRequired.note: It is the hub for Google Home.

localControl.note: Not confirmed from the pages we read.

hubType.note: A smart display that works as a hub for Google Home.

deviceProtocols.note: Thread devices connect through the built-in border router. Matter devices are supported on Wi-Fi as well.

threadBorderRouter.note: Google's Thread page lists Nest Hub (2nd gen) among Google products that can act as a Thread border router. The page gives no Thread version.

maxDevices.note: No limit found in the sources.

summary: The Nest Hub 2nd Gen (UK) slots into Google Home as its hub: the smart display works as its hub and has a built-in Thread border router. Google's UK spec page lists Matter as supported. It runs on dual-band Wi-Fi with Bluetooth 5.0. Nothing official shows devices paired through it appearing in Apple Home, Alexa or SmartThings.
caveats: Matter support rests on Google's own pages; no CSA listing naming this model was found.
Google's Thread help page gives no Thread version for the Nest Hub (2nd gen).
Nothing official shows devices paired through it appearing in Apple Home, Alexa, SmartThings or Home Assistant.
